chunks: And Ḥammād narrated from al-Ḥalabī, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:

Regarding a bondwoman who was between two owners, and one of them emancipated his share, he عليه السلام said: “If he is financially capable, he is required to guarantee compensation. And if he is financially incapable, she is made to serve according to the shares.”

key_terms.بِالْحِصَصِ: according to the respective ownership shares
key_terms.يَضْمَنَ: to compensate or guarantee payment for the other share

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if one co-owner frees his share of a jointly owned bondwoman?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling about partial emancipation of a jointly owned bondwoman. If the partner who frees his share is financially able, he must compensate for the remaining share; if he is not able, her service remains divided according to ownership shares.
